onboarding/ghl-onboarding-handoff.rule.s: As the tenant admin, call ghl/listApprovedContacts for the org.

Assert it returns an array; for each approved row assert the lifecycle fields the queue renders are present and correctly typed — id (string), registered/emailIsPlaceholder/hasLinkedUser (booleans), onboardingLinkSentAt (null until a link is sent, never undefined).
Call ghl/sendOnboardingLink with a non-existent pendingId.
Assert a clean 404 NOT_FOUND ('Approved contact not found') — the hand-off wiring maps a missing contact to a proper error, never an opaque 500, and no email is dispatched.
